title: Cancel an exceptional factor without proving it invertible
situation: Minimal projection of the exceptional-factor policy: z*x=0 has solutions on z=0 even when x is nonzero.
attempted_conclusion: Every point satisfying z*x=0 also satisfies x=0.

expected.reason: The point z=0, x=1 is an exact counterexample; cancelling z discards the exceptional component.
